first_principles.objects: 38 actual elliptic curves E/Q in general Weierstrass form and isogeny labels supplied by a pinned ecdata release; conductor N, rank r and torsion size T are source attributes, and discriminant Delta and j are derived exactly from five integer a-invariants before float coordinate conversion.
first_principles.domain_and_assumptions: All Weierstrass coefficients are integers; Delta is nonzero. Isogeny rank invariance is known. Class labels are arithmetic source identifiers, not observed cosmological classifications. Exact source lines are frozen before inference.
first_principles.coordinate_rules: ACSC-like: [ln|Delta|/ln(10^30), ln N/ln(10^9), (200 m*r)/(200 m)]; comparison MCJ-inspired BSD-independent: [ln N/ln(10^9), asinh(j/1728)/40, ln(1+T)/ln(13)]; j=c4^3/Delta. Deliberate MCJ modification avoids undefined ln(j) at j=0 and degenerate imaginary coordinate for rational j.
first_principles.dimensional_analysis: Every coordinate and Euclidean comparison is dimensionless; rank altitude 200 m is canceled by 200 m, and neither map gives celestial coordinates, curvature, measured SFR or cosmological distance.
first_principles.known_no_go: Conductor is invariant under Q-isogeny and rank is explicitly an ACSC coordinate; comparing class labels without conditioning on conductor AND rank is circular. Conditional shuffles mitigate but do not prove a nontrivial correspondence. Coordinate scale choices remain conventional.
first_principles.nonclaims: No observational, physical ACSC, ECC, GLMPCT, RTCH, BSD, bijection, or theorem support. A p-value is not a mechanism.

cohort_rule: Exactly the 38 source rows declared by 1-based source_line in curves.csv: the 38 explicitly listed records from conductors 26,37,38,50,54,57,58 as specified there; no post-result replacements, row dropping, imputation or duplicates; cohort is intentionally selective, not random.

primary_endpoint.definition: T = average_by_conductor(mean_distance_between_classes - mean_distance_within_class) for ACSC, minus the identical quantity for modified MCJ; Euclidean metric on stated coordinates
primary_endpoint.null: 999 Fisher-Yates shuffles of isogeny labels ONLY within each (conductor, rank) stratum; observations and feature vectors held fixed; complete observed class multiplicities in each conditional block preserved. Conditioning on rank is required because rank appears in ACSC coordinates.
primary_endpoint.notes: Protocol frozen as part of the same exploratory result commit, not prospectively preregistered. A conductor-only shuffle initially produced p=0.005; after examining that result, the null was amended to condition on rank because rank is a direct ACSC coordinate. Both values are preserved; neither is confirmatory.

controls: Recompute j and Delta from general Weierstrass integer invariants; reject singular curves and mismatched pinned source rows.
Hold N and rank fixed in each label permutation to avoid tautological rank or conductor gains.
Compare a BSD-independent alternative map; no analytic ranks or BSD values computed.
Ablation of distance scaling, cohort enlargement and observational nulls remain not executed and are listed as discrepancies.
falsifiers: A conditional random label permutation has T >= observed T (no exceptional geometry).
The analysis collapses after a defensible coordinate-scale change or conductor/cohort resampling.
Source lines or arithmetic identities fail independent verification.
numerical_uncertainty: Monte Carlo standard error of the empirical tail proportion is stored in result.json; only 999 random shuffles. Float rounding 12 decimals is display-only; comparisons use unrounded double floats with documented 1e-14 tie tolerance. Scaling robustness is unresolved.
unresolved_discrepancies: Mapping-coordinate rescaling and sensitivity to j outliers are not evaluated.
Only 38 purposively selected low-conductor curves, with no held-out source bands or new observations.
Isogeny labels and features are both arithmetic: conditional association is not independent physical evidence.
No independently reproduced output or Sage/eclib invariant cross-check.

observational_stage.separate_future_study: Use SDSS DR18/MaNGA/GAMA pinned data; construct a justified physical observable, survey selection and redshift map; ensure train/validation cohort separation; compare controlled arithmetic/astronomical and spatially constrained nulls; require no Sandbox scientific-status promotion.
